question: Can you give me an overview of our website traffic for December 2020? I'm particularly interested in the channel with the fourth highest number of sessions.
sql:
WITH session_traffic AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    event_date,
    (SELECT p.value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) p WHERE p.key = 'ga_session_id') as ga_session_id,
    traffic_source.medium as ts_medium,
    traffic_source.source as ts_source,
    traffic_source.name as ts_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN ts_source = '(direct)' AND ts_medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('baidu','bing','duckduckgo','ecosia','google','yahoo','yandex') 
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('baidu','bing','duckduckgo','ecosia','google','yahoo','yandex') 
           AND ts_medium = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('alibaba','amazon','google shopping','shopify','etsy','ebay','stripe','walmart')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('alibaba','amazon','google shopping','shopify','etsy','ebay','stripe','walmart')
           AND ts_medium = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_source, r'^(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp)$')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_source, r'^(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp)$')
           AND ts_medium IN ('social','social-network','social-media','sm','social network','social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('dailymotion','disneyplus','netflix','youtube','vimeo','twitch')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('dailymotion','disneyplus','netflix','youtube','vimeo','twitch')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'^(.*video.*)$') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN ts_medium IN ('display','banner','expandable','interstitial','cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN ts_medium = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN ts_medium = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN ts_medium = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN ts_source = 'sms' OR ts_medium = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'push$') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'mobile|notification') THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('email','e-mail','e_mail','e mail') OR ts_medium IN ('email','e-mail','e_mail','e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN ts_medium = 'organic' AND ts_source NOT IN ('baidu','bing','duckduckgo','ecosia','google','yahoo','yandex') THEN 'Organic Search'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END as channel
  FROM session_traffic
)
SELECT 
  channel,
  COUNT(*) as session_count
FROM classified
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY session_count DESC
